body.x: QINGDAO, China (AVING) -- <Visual News> Hanwang presented its UMPC 'T700' in China market during SINOCES 2007, which enhanced recognition ability of Chinese character writing. Adopting 7-inch TFT-LCD screen(800x400), the T700 supports VIA C7M Nano processor 1GHz CPU, 512MB memory, 40GB hard disk, VIA VN 800 graphic card, wireless 802.11b/g and Bluetooth connectivity.
